result.rationale: The diff in EventManager.ts adds `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = evt.destinationCalendar ?? [];` and then `if (evt.location === MeetLocationType && mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration !== "google_calendar")`, dropping the old optional chaining (`evt.destinationCalendar?.integration`). Destructuring an empty/null array yields undefined, so `.integration` throws. handleNewBooking in this same diff now sets `destinationCalendar: ... : null` in some paths, so this null case is reachable.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts`, the new logic destructures `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = evt.destinationCalendar ?? [];` and then unconditionally reads `mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration`. If `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null` or `[]`, `mainHostDestinationCalendar` is `undefined` and this throws `TypeError` on `.integration`. The previous code used optional chaining (`evt.destinationCalendar?.integration`) and would not crash. The diff also shows `handleNewBooking` can set `destinationCalendar: ... : null`, making this crash path reachable when the Meet fallback comment says it should be handled.
